title: Time steals poetry Not memories lost Emotions shifted Events unfolded Words unfurled meaning Ensconced in History #smallpoems
summary: Time steals poetry Not memories lost Emotions shifted Events unfolded Words unfurled meaning Ensconced in History #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Time steals poetry
Not memories lost
Emotions shifted
Events unfolded
Words unfurled
meaning
Ensconced in
History
#smallpoems
